label: default_ice
reference_prompt:
Create a close visual reference for naturally frozen solid ice in a bleak grounded dark-fantasy climate.

The ice should have real depth: compressed translucent layers, trapped pale air, faint internal fractures and subtle cloudy zones where freezing was uneven. Its surface has been scoured by cold wind and fine snow, so it is neither perfectly clear nor glossy like glass.

Use restrained blue-gray, cold cyan and milky neutral tones with darkness appearing through depth rather than painted outlines. Avoid jewel-like crystal, magical glow, mirror polish, dramatic shattered cracks or a clean stock photograph of an ice cube.

The reference should make cold, density and ancient winter physically palpable while remaining an authored game-world material, free of any imposed tile composition.
